# REL-64: Money-saved metrics: revenue recovered and investigation time saved

Status: **Done** | Phase 5 - Showcase polish | Owner: Claude | issue #404

## Outcome

The API reports, for a time window, the revenue Relay recovered and the investigation time it saved, from stored data only

- [REL-62](REL-62.md) Phase 5 decisions and three console design directions - Done

## Acceptance

- [x] `/analytics` gains `money_saved`: revenue recovered per currency and payments rescued, split by rescue path (failover to the other processor, retry), counted from payments that failed an attempt on one processor and were captured on a later attempt; the definition is in `docs/product/metrics.md`
- [x] Investigation time saved: per explained final failure, the 2-hour manual baseline of ADR-0009 minus the measured time to explanation, summed and reported with its definition and the label 'estimated against the 2-hour manual baseline'; never presented as measured time saved
- [x] Tests with fixtures written through the real event code: each rescue path, a payment that failed on both processors (not rescued), currencies kept separate, the time-saved arithmetic, and empty windows
